text:
olivia-mktg: Quick flag from the weekly KPI pass 1 — launch posts showing huge click/engagement lift but attribution cards show flat MQLs. Looks off to me. Anyone else seeing this? :confused:
nico-analytics: I see it too. CTR up ~2.3x on LinkedIn posts, landing-to-reg rate healthy, but the MQL funnel doesn't move. Pulling channel matchback now.
harry-growth: Could be attribution window differences. Our dashboard uses last-touch 7d for MQLs but marketing benchmark uses 14d. That was changed in Jan.
zoe-ops: Also, FYI we deployed a small change to the inbound parser last week that collapsed some utm_medium values (linkedin, linkedin-spon) into one token. If the dashboard relies on exact medium labels it could drop some rows.
nico-analytics: sharing quick debug snippet: ```sql
-- registrations by utm_medium
SELECT utm_medium, count(*) as regs
FROM events
WHERE campaign_name = 'spring_launch_posts'
  AND event_date >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY regs DESC;
```
ingest-bot: Data pipeline notice: inbound-parser v1.4 deployed 2026-03-18T04:11Z, schema change: utm_medium normalization.
olivia-mktg: ok that explains some mismatch. For the deck narrative I want: "Launch posts driving above-benchmark engagement; attribution underreporting due to recent parser normalization and shorter MQL window. Fix & re-evaluate." Keep it succinct.
harry-growth: Agreed. Action items: (1) ops to revert or map normalized mediums back to legacy labels for dashboard backfill; (2) analytics to recompute MQLs with 14d window and present delta card; (3) add a tiny note on benchmark slide calling out the temporary instrumentation change.
zoe-ops: I'll add a mapping layer and kick a backfill job. ETA ~3 hours. Will also add an alert if parser changes alter medium cardinality by >5%.
nico-analytics: I'll produce a before/after metric table and push updated slides to the KPI deck link: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch/kpi-weekly (private).
olivia-mktg: Thanks all. One last ask 1 can we add a micro-card showing "attribution window variance" (7d vs 14d delta) so PMs see impact immediately? Keeps the postmortem clean.
harry-growth: good idea. I'll wire that into the next dashboard iteration. Reconvene Friday if backfill changes the headline numbers. :calendar:
